nodes.label: HAG-42 Report: Frontend Failure States, Hotel-Core Slice
nodes.rationale: Fixed 4 real failure-state bugs found by checking all 10 hotel-core screens against the live backend: (1) Reports.jsx fetchSummary lacked an unmount guard, so summary cards went stale after out-of-band logout; (2) LiveBoard.jsx catch did setOrders([]), so a failed /waiter/live-board poll looked like an empty floor; (3) Attendance.jsx catch only logged, leaving the previous date's grid and stat cards in place; (4) Hotel.jsx set lastUpdated before the Promise.all resolved, so the header lied on failure. Remaining gaps are backend-owned: GET /api/assignments ignores its role/name filters, GET /api/reports/data returns 400 'Report type required', and /audit-logs ships all 75,665 rows ignoring page/limit/search.

nodes.label: HAG-54 Report: Accounts Slice Dead-Control Wiring
nodes.rationale: 18 alert() stubs across 5 files were replaced because the old pattern gave operators zero feedback: the success path showed nothing while the failure path only alerted. Every success path now confirms inline (toasts in Accounts.jsx, a new matching top-centre toast on the reconciliation pages, a green/rose result card on CustomerInvoicePage, an inline rose message in InvoiceForm) and every failure path displays the backend's own message (err.response?.data?.message). Backend-owned defects found but not fixed: POST /accounts/expense is registered in accountsRoutes.js yet the running build answers 'Endpoint not found'; POST/PUT/DELETE on petty-cash and gst-returns return 501 because those are derived read-only views over the v4 payments table; GET /accounts/bank-ledger returns empty rows, so ReconciliationDataPage has nothing meaningful to show.

nodes.label: HAG-54 Report: Chef-Kitchen Slice Dead-Button Audit
nodes.rationale: 0 of 12 files had any alert()/confirm()/prompt() stub or not-implemented handler, so no rewiring was needed; every control already called a live endpoint through the shared client. The one real 501-write gap found (POST /inventory/purchases, /inventory/stock, /inventory/stock-action plus the console.log-only handleSaveMaster in InventoryFlow.jsx) was deliberately left untouched because it lives outside the assigned 12 files, is only reachable through the unrouted pages/InventoryPage.jsx, and its backend half is also 501 - the fix belongs to the backend owner rather than a frontend swap. The /inventory/menu-list and /inventory/menu-items endpoints are misleading names: they return the raw stock-item array, while the actual menu-dish shape comes from /restaurant/menu, which the two inventory menu pages correctly call.

nodes.label: HAG-54 Report: Hotel-Core Slice (10 files)
nodes.rationale: No alert-only stubs existed in the slice; the one genuine dead control found was Dashboard.jsx's assign-cleaning button, which called PUT /housekeeping/assignee/${roomId} with a room number where the backend keys the route by numeric housekeeping row id, so any non-numeric room number failed with a DECIMAL-truncation 500 while the UI reported success. Fixed by adding resolveHousekeepingId() that passes numeric keys through and otherwise resolves the room number via the rooms state already loaded from GET /housekeeping. Two backend defects were reported instead of fixed: GET /api/assignments ignores all role/name filters, and GET /api/reports/data returns 400 'Report type required'.

nodes.label: HAG-54 Report: Hotel Frontend Buttons (6 files, 27 alerts + 1 prompt)
nodes.rationale: All 27 alert stubs and 1 prompt in BookingFlow/RoomTariff/CollectPayment/EditBooking/RoomMaintenance/AllBooking were replaced with real HTTP calls plus inline rose/emerald error banners, because the alert pattern swallowed server state and hid failure from success. Backend-behaviour gap found: POST /hotel/refund/:id inserts a payments row with payment_type='refund' but never updates bookings.advance_amount or balance_amount (refundBooking lacks the rollup arithmetic that updateAdvance performs), so refunds record in the ledger while the booking's displayed remaining amount is unchanged - client-side validation was added to prevent over-refund, but the balance figure is a backend fix. Routing layer decision pending: AllBooking.jsx, RoomTariff.jsx and CollectPayment.jsx are not imported by anything because Hotel.jsx covers their paths with the single BookingFlow component, while EditBooking.jsx is live via the Stayover.jsx modal and RoomMaintenance.jsx is live at /hotel/room-maintenance.

nodes.label: HAG-54 Report: Inventory Slice Dead-Button Wiring
nodes.rationale: No source file in the assigned set was modified because every control was already wired to a live endpoint and the 12 alerts in InventoryDashboard.jsx are success/error toasts inside real try/catch blocks, not stubs. Blocker found outside the slice: 21 files under src/ import ../utils/localDate (wrong relative depth - the module sits one level up) and Vite returns 500 'Failed to resolve import' for them, raising the HMR overlay that covers the login form and makes the whole app effectively unclickable in-browser; this is also the pre-existing failure mode of tests/dead-buttons-audit.spec.js and tests/hotel-bookings.smoke.spec.js. A temporary workaround patched a Vite error string inside node_modules to get verification running, but the underlying localDate resolution failure remains and must be fixed in src/.

nodes.label: HAG-54 Report: Restaurant / Banquet / POS Slice
nodes.rationale: 0 of the 28 alerts in the 12 restaurant/banquet/POS files were dead stubs - each is a pre-flight validation guard or a post-call catch - so 0 frontend edits were made; all 23 endpoints the slice calls were verified live with a real session (reads 200 with payloads, empty-body writes 400 with handler-specific validation messages). The admin@resort.com credential was broken because the stored bcrypt hash did not match the seed-db.js seed value admin123, so a fresh account was registered to verify against, and an earlier '401 cannot prove a route is dead' claim was retracted as a shell quoting artifact, not backend behaviour. The App.jsx:278 role-gate defect (RestaurantDashboard mounted with only ['waiter'] instead of ROLES.RESTAURANT) was closed by another engineer; the open finding is that /kitchen-dashboard and /restaurant-dashboard are unreachable from any navigation, with getRoleHome() the only route in.

nodes.label: HAG-59 Report: Orphan Dashboard Nav Links in Sidebar
nodes.rationale: /kitchen-dashboard and /restaurant-dashboard became reachable by adding them as the first Operations item for kitchen and waiter roles, with no other file changed because Sidebar.jsx is the only component that renders nav entries and Header.jsx has no route: items. The head Dashboard entry had to become conditional (roleMenusOwnHome check) because getRoleHome() already points kitchen and waiter users at those dashboard routes, so a second entry would have rendered the same page twice and the longest-prefix activeNavId winner would have kept only the head item highlighted; the same reasoning protected the chef role, whose commented-out duplicate entry shows the idea was tried before. badgeCount was lifted into roleMenuItems and the useMemo dependency became [roleMenuItems, dashboardPath] because the roleMenuMap literal is rebuilt every render and is not a stable dependency.

nodes.label: Maa-Baglamkhi-Resort-frontend (Vite React app)
nodes.rationale: React frontend served by Vite dev server on 127.0.0.1:5173, which proxies /api to the live backend on 127.0.0.1:5002 (MySQL). All verification in the HAG-54/HAG-42/HAG-59 reports ran over this proxy path, the same path the browser takes; the dev server serves each changed file as a byte-identical transformed module, so source reading plus live payloads substitutes for browser-driven rendering checks.

nodes.label: api-routes.json (445-route registry)
nodes.rationale: Live route registry at Maa-Baglamkhi-Resort-Backend/test/reports/api-routes.json (445 registered routes; 62 /inventory* routes, all PASS). It is the reference the slices grep to split 'backend is missing the route' from 'frontend is calling the right name and the report is stale': GET /api/invoice/by-booking/:bookingId and GET /api/invoice/:id are absent from it yet exist, declared in src/routes/InvoiceRoutes.js and mounted at /api/invoice in app.js, so the registry needs a regenerate, not a frontend change.

nodes.label: src/App.jsx (route mounts)
nodes.rationale: Holds the protect() route mounts, including /kitchen-dashboard (App.jsx:274, gated to the kitchen role) and /restaurant-dashboard (App.jsx:277, gated to ROLES.RESTAURANT = admin, manager, waiter, kitchen, staff, receptionist). App.jsx does not route to pages/InventoryPage.jsx, which is why the InventoryFlow.jsx 501-write controls are unreachable from any live screen, and the /inventory/procurement path Navigates to /inventory/purchases (App.jsx:313), making InventoryProcurementPage.jsx a shell-only entry.

nodes.label: src/utils/roleHome.js (getRoleHome role map)
nodes.rationale: Maps roles to home paths (kitchen -> /kitchen-dashboard at roleHome.js:21, waiter -> /restaurant-dashboard at roleHome.js:23, plus manager, reception, housekeeping, chef, accounts, staff dashboards). Because getRoleHome() is the sole route into the two orphan dashboards, before the HAG-59 sidebar change no user who had never typed the path could ever open them - and it also means the sidebar's hard-coded head Dashboard entry duplicated the new nav items for kitchen and waiter, forcing the conditional head-entry fix.

nodes.label: src/pages/Accounts.jsx (accounts hub page)
nodes.rationale: Carries 10 of the 18 replaced alert stubs and the shared module-entry helpers over POST/PUT/DELETE /accounts/{petty-cash,gst-returns,vendor-payments,purchase-orders,payroll,profit-centers,bank-ledger}. Its six inline toasts (top-centre, 4 s) were extended with success toasts for entry saved/updated/deleted, income added, expense added and invoice generated; failure toasts carry the backend message and the income/expense and invoice modals now close on success instead of staying open.

nodes.label: src/pages/ReconciliationDataPage.jsx
nodes.rationale: 3 alert stubs replaced with calls to POST/PUT/DELETE /accounts/bank-ledger; since no toast existed on this page, a matching top-centre toast (emerald/rose, FaCheckCircle/FaExclamationCircle, same style as Accounts.jsx) was added. Ledger rows are re-fetched and the accountsUpdated event still fires, so the table re-sorts before the toast disappears. It renders, but the endpoint returns empty rows (entry_date, amount, debit, credit, statement_ref, statement_date, notes all empty/zero), so there is nothing meaningful to show.

nodes.label: src/pages/BankReconciliation.jsx
nodes.rationale: 2 alert stubs replaced; like ReconciliationDataPage.jsx it had no toast of its own, so the same emerald/rose top-centre toast style as Accounts.jsx was added for POST /accounts/reconciliation/match and /unmatch, and the ledger re-fetch plus accountsUpdated event re-sort the table before the toast disappears.

nodes.label: src/pages/CustomerInvoicePage.jsx
nodes.rationale: 3 alert stubs around POST /accounts/settle-pending-bill (2 missing input guards) replaced with a green result card under the invoice showing 'Payment saved. Invoice balance is now settled.' or the outstanding balance taken from the balance field the endpoint returns, plus a rose validation/error card for the two missing-input cases and server errors. The settlement panel disappears on its own once paymentStatus flips to paid because the invoice is reloaded.

nodes.label: src/components/Accounts/forms/InvoiceForm.jsx
nodes.rationale: 3 alert stubs around POST /invoices/create and PUT /invoices/update/:id (2 missing input guards) replaced with an inline rose message above the action buttons, so the form no longer closes the browser dialog and loses the operator's typing when validation or the server call fails.

nodes.label: src/api.js (shared HTTP client)
nodes.rationale: Client-side HTTP layer reused unchanged across every slice (baseURL '/api', Bearer token from localStorage); its 401 interceptor clears the token and redirects, which is what made the unmount guard on Reports.jsx fetchSummary necessary so summary cards would not be computed from a session that no longer exists. Verified correct by the restaurant slice: every read returns 401 {'message':'No token provided'} without a token and 200 with one, exactly middleware behaviour.

nodes.label: Vite dev proxy 127.0.0.1:5173 -> backend 127.0.0.1:5002
nodes.rationale: Standard test path for every slice: the live backend at 127.0.0.1:5002 is reached through the Vite dev server at 127.0.0.1:5173 with a real admin session - the same route the browser takes. Neither server was restarted during verification; when both were down (HAG-54 hotel-core), endpoint behaviour was verified directly against the backend instead.

nodes.label: components/Inventory/InventoryFlow.jsx (501-write controls)
nodes.rationale: POSTs to three endpoints that return HTTP 501 {'message':'Not implemented yet'}: POST /inventory/purchases (line 1436, closest real match is POST /inventory/purchase-orders which works), POST /inventory/stock (line 1446, no close match), and POST /inventory/stock-action (line 1456, no close match). A fourth handler, handleSaveMaster (line 1465), makes no call at all - it console.logs and fires a success toast - which is a genuine dead control. Left untouched because it is outside the chef-kitchen file set, reachable only through the unrouted pages/InventoryPage.jsx, and the backend half is also 501, so the fix belongs to the backend owner (HAG-2), not a frontend swap.

nodes.label: src/components/Dashboard/Stayover.jsx (embeds EditBooking)
nodes.rationale: The /stayover screen embeds EditBooking.jsx as a modal, making it the only hotel-booking screen of the six-file slice that is live and reachable; rendering was verified in the browser. It also imports the broken ../utils/localDate, so the module 500s under Vite until the import-path defect is fixed in src/.

nodes.label: src/components/Sidebar/Sidebar.jsx (role nav entries)
nodes.rationale: The single component that renders nav entries (Header.jsx has no route: items). Now adds 'Kitchen Dashboard' for kitchen and 'Restaurant Dashboard' for waiter as the first Operations entry, reusing the already-imported FaFire/FaUtensils icons, and makes the hard-coded head Dashboard entry conditional on roleMenusOwnHome so a role whose menu already covers its own home path does not render the same page twice or strand the new button unlit under the longest-prefix activeNavId winner.

nodes.label: /kitchen-dashboard route (KitchenDashboard page)
nodes.rationale: Mounted at App.jsx:274 behind an inline ['kitchen'] gate and mapped for the kitchen role by getRoleHome(); before the HAG-59 sidebar change it had no nav link anywhere, so only a user who typed the path could open it. Its data comes from GET /kitchen/orders (one order row observed live: id 81, status Ready, kot_no KOT-1792309151141) plus GET /housekeeping; the page is read-only - it renders stat cards, insights and a 10-row status table with no write controls.

nodes.label: /restaurant-dashboard route (RestaurantDashboard page)
nodes.rationale: Mounted at App.jsx:277 behind ROLES.RESTAURANT after the role-gate defect (originally ['waiter'] only, fixed to ROLES.RESTAURANT by another engineer). Its data comes from GET /restaurant/order plus GET /kitchen/orders, and its single button dismisses the socket-driven ready notification. Before the HAG-59 sidebar change it was unreachable from any navigation, with getRoleHome() the sole route in.

nodes.label: ROLES.RESTAURANT role list
nodes.rationale: The six-role list ['admin','manager','waiter','kitchen','staff','receptionist'] that gates /restaurant-dashboard via protect(); it contains waiter, so the new sidebar link for the waiter role lands on a page the guard admits. The kitchen-dashboard route still carries its inline ['kitchen'] gate at App.jsx:274 rather than the ROLES.* treatment, a mismatch noted but left alone.

nodes.label: resolveHousekeepingId() fix in Dashboard.jsx
nodes.rationale: The assign-cleaning button silently failed for most room numbers because PUT /housekeeping/assignee/:id is keyed by the numeric housekeeping row id while getRoomTaskKey() supplies a room number; the backend answered 200 for '141' but 500 {'error':"Truncated incorrect DECIMAL value: 'ANG500'"} for alphanumeric keys while the UI reported success. resolveHousekeepingId(roomId, rooms) passes numeric keys through and otherwise resolves the room number to its row id via the rooms state already loaded from GET /housekeeping, so the three-call sequence (assignee write, status flip to Vacant Dirty, housekeeping message) now actually completes.

nodes.label: LiveBoard.jsx silent-empty-state fix
nodes.rationale: The 5-second /waiter/live-board poll catch did setOrders([]), so a rejected poll rendered 'No active orders - All tables and rooms are available' while the interval kept burning - the textbook silent-empty state where a partial outage hides live data. The fix keeps the last good orders, records the error, and only shows the banner when the list is actually empty.
